target_customer: Small and micro businesses in India that need GST invoicing and bookkeeping
problem: Small Indian merchants must issue GST compliant invoices, e-way bills and returns but cannot afford accountants or desktop accounting software.
business_model: Mobile-first SaaS subscription for billing and bookkeeping, with integrated banking and lending features
product_category: GST billing and bookkeeping app for SMBs

founders.name: Yash Agrawal
founders.background_notes: Only founder on the YC page. Inc42 names Meghal Agarwal and Ujjwal Agarwal as co-founders (seen in a search snippet, page not opened), so they are not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Invoicing, GST return and e-way bill integration with government portals is mostly standard app development with compliance details.

defensibility.rationale: Many billing apps exist and invoice history creates modest lock-in; distribution through app downloads is the main advantage.

market_need_then: The company's site reports 40 lakh plus downloads and 1 crore plus invoices created by 2026, indicating heavy small business demand for GST invoicing; YourStory in 2021 said GimBooks had nearly two million installs.

branding.name_origin: Inc42 says the startup began as a GST Invoice Management (GIM) provider, which suggests the name; no source states this as the naming rationale.

identity.voice_and_tone: India's most powerful and easy-to-use GST Invoice Manager

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search found no source on name origin or identity, only product marketing.

outcome_analysis: GimBooks grew as a bootstrapped GST billing app before raising its first seed round in September 2021 from First Check Ventures and Y Combinator. Its site now reports millions of downloads and it remains active, with no later round, exit or shutdown found in searches.
notes: Seed reported by YourStory, Indian Startup News and others; amounts conflict (a YourStory Tech50 profile says 315,000 dollars, an aggregator says 260K, one outlet shows Y Combinator at 125,000), so amount is null. The YourStory page returned HTTP 403 when fetched, so the round is taken from the search result summaries of multiple outlets. Competitor lists found (Vyapar, myBillBook, Zoho, KhataBuddy) came from undated aggregator comparison pages, so the list is empty. Legal entity named inconsistently (Gim Info Solutions vs GIM Infotech). Founding year 2017 per YC, 2018 per other sources.
